digest.component_or_area: external integration tests / LLM provider seam
propositions: Live LLM execution does not run in external tier; test_single_turn_live_structured_output fails with status 'failed' due to missing prompt file in snapshot because test writes artifact to working tree without committing it.

test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict reports llm_ran=False because the plan fixture lacks a Testing section, triggering the DET P10 blocking floor that short-circuits LLM execution without running the provider call.
Both test failures are masked by SnapshotRefError until bug 8070 is applied, revealing pre-existing defects in test setup rather than product behavior.
write_project_prompt() must commit artifacts to snapshot, not leave them in working tree, to comply with REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=attested semantics.
Plan fixture for live workflow test must include a Testing section to pass the P10 verification guard and proceed to real LLM execution.
